results.title: How a mentor's example helped Chris Brooks Jr. earn a bigger role at Wisconsin
results.description: The personal and football lessons Chris Brooks Jr. learned from a close friend have helped him become a respected voice on the Badgers roster.

results.title: 49ers coach Kyle Shanahan corrects record, says crash was his fault
results.description: Making his first public comments since being part of a head-on car accident earlier this month, Kyle Shanahan admitted fault on Tuesday for the collision that left him with serious injuries.
